text: Hello, I'm Neil.
And I'm Georgie.
Welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 欢迎收听《真实简单英语》。
zh_hant: 歡迎收聽《真實簡單英語》。

text: You can find a worksheet and transcript for this episode on our website,
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到本集的练习册和文字稿，
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上找到本集的練習冊和文字稿，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Hello Neil, how are you doing?
zh: 你好，尼尔，你最近怎么样？
zh_hant: 你好，尼爾，你最近怎麼樣？

text: I'm very well, thank you Georgie.
How are you?
Yes, I'm very well, thank you.
Neil, today we're talking about cities.
zh: 尼尔，今天我们聊聊城市。
zh_hant: 尼爾，今天我們聊聊城市。

text: We both live and work in London, which is a very big city.
zh: 我们都住在伦敦并在这里工作，这是个非常大的城市。
zh_hant: 我們都住在倫敦並在這裡工作，這是個非常大的城市。

text: It is.
It's a huge city,
very busy and bustling.
means there's lots of activity, lots of things
zh: 意思是活动很多，事情很多
zh_hant: 意思是活動很多，事情很多

text: going on, busy.
Speaking of, what do you like about living in a big,
zh: 说到这个，你喜欢住在大城市里的什么？
zh_hant: 說到這個，你喜歡住在大城市裡的什麼？

text: bustling city?
Well, there are lots of good things about living in a big city.
zh: 嗯，住在大城市有很多好处。
zh_hant: 嗯，住在大城市有很多好處。

text: It's convenient.
It's very convenient.
So there is lots of public transport,
which is sometimes good.
And you can get things that you need quite easily.
zh: 而且你可以很容易地得到你需要的东西。
zh_hant: 而且你可以很容易地得到你需要的東西。

text: That's very true.
Yeah.
There's also a lot of things to do.
zh: 还有，可以做的事情也很多。
zh_hant: 還有，可以做的事情也很多。

text: We are lucky in London to have lots of theatres
zh: 我们很幸运，伦敦有很多剧院，
zh_hant: 我們很幸運，倫敦有很多劇院，

text: where you can see plays.
There's a really good music scene,
so you can watch and listen to a lot of live music.
zh: 所以你可以观看和收听很多现场音乐。
zh_hant: 所以你可以觀看和收聽很多現場音樂。

text: If you have no plans on a day,
you can always find plans, spontaneous plans.
zh: 你总能找到计划，临时的计划。
zh_hant: 你總能找到計劃，臨時的計劃。

text: So we are really lucky in that sense.
zh: 所以从这个角度看，我们真的很幸运。
zh_hant: 所以從這個角度看，我們真的很幸運。

text: Yeah.
And if you like art,
there's all kinds of exhibitions and galleries
and museums.
Lots of good things.
But there are obviously some bad things about living in a city, aren't there?
zh: 但是住在城市里显然也有一些不好的地方，不是吗？
zh_hant: 但是住在城市裡顯然也有一些不好的地方，不是嗎？

text: Yes.
Do you want to tell us some?
Yeah.
Well, it's very noisy and dirty and busy and expensive.
zh: 嗯，那里又吵又脏，又繁忙又昂贵。
zh_hant: 嗯，那裡又吵又髒，又繁忙又昂貴。

text: Yeah.
It's always more expensive in a big city,
zh: 大城市的物价总是更贵，
zh_hant: 大城市的物價總是更貴，

text: especially the capital city.
So you can do all of the things that we just talked about.
zh: 所以你可以做我们刚才说的所有事情。
zh_hant: 所以你可以做我們剛才說的所有事情。

text: Yeah, but you have to pay.
Yeah, and things like eating out, especially going
zh: 是啊，还有比如外出就餐，特别是去
zh_hant: 是啊，還有比如外出就餐，特別是去

text: for a drink, is a really expensive thing to do in a capital city.
zh: 喝一杯，在首都城市是很贵的。
zh_hant: 喝一杯，在首都城市是很貴的。

text: I feel like every time I leave the house, I just spend loads of money,
zh: 我感觉每次出门，我都会花很多钱，
zh_hant: 我感覺每次出門，我都會花很多錢，

text: and that is quite frustrating.
But you have to pay for good times, I guess.
zh: 但美好的时光得花钱买，我想。
zh_hant: 但美好的時光得花錢買，我想。

text: Yeah.
Have you ever lived in another city apart from London?
zh: 除了伦敦，你住过其他城市吗？
zh_hant: 除了倫敦，你住過其他城市嗎？

text: Yes, I have.
I used to live in Barcelona,
which is quite different to London
because it has a beach and the sea on one side,
zh: 因为它一边有海滩和大海，
zh_hant: 因為它一邊有海灘和大海，

text: and on the other side it has mountains.
So it's contained by nature,
and you can get to the nature quite quickly,
zh: 你可以很快到自然中去，
zh_hant: 你可以很快到自然中去，

text: which is really nice.
What about you?
Have you lived anywhere different?
Yeah, I've lived in a few big cities,
zh: 住过，我住过几个大城市，
zh_hant: 住過，我住過幾個大城市，

text: a few capital cities, actually.
zh: 实际上是一些首都城市。
zh_hant: 實際上是一些首都城市。

text: I've also lived in Spain, but in Madrid.
zh: 我也在西班牙住过，但在马德里。
zh_hant: 我也在西班牙住過，但在馬德里。

text: I lived and worked in Prague,
zh: 我在布拉格住过并工作过，
zh_hant: 我在布拉格住過並工作過，

text: and it's a beautiful city.
Yeah.
The architecture looks fantastic.
Nice buildings.
Talking about nice buildings,
I lived in Edinburgh
because I did my master's degree there.
And that has beautiful buildings.
I loved that city.
It has a castle on a big rock in the middle,
zh: 它中间有座建在大岩石上的城堡，
zh_hant: 它中間有座建在大岩石上的城堡，

text: and it's just amazing to look at.
So we've talked about cities we've been to.
zh: 我们聊了去过的一些城市。
zh_hant: 我們聊了去過的一些城市。

text: What about the future?
Are there any cities you really want to visit, or maybe even live in?
zh: 有没有你特别想去，甚至想住的城市？
zh_hant: 有沒有你特別想去，甚至想住的城市？

text: Oh, that's an interesting question.
I've never been to Georgia or Armenia or that part of the world,
zh: 我从未去过格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚或世界的那一部分，
zh_hant: 我從未去過喬治亞、亞美尼亞或世界的那一部分，

text: so I'm going to say I'd like to go to Tbilisi, in Georgia.
zh: 所以我想说，我想到格鲁吉亚的第比利斯。
zh_hant: 所以我想說，我想到喬治亞的第比利斯。

text: That's a good answer.
I'd love to go there as well.
For me, I'm desperate to go to Latin America.
zh: 对我来说，我很想去拉丁美洲。
zh_hant: 對我來說，我很想去拉丁美洲。

text: I really want to go to Rio de Janeiro at the time
zh: 我真的很想在那个时候去里约热内卢
zh_hant: 我真的很想在那個時候去里約熱內盧

text: when the carnival is there,
because that sounds really fun and I like to party.
zh: 因为那听起来真的很好玩，我喜欢派对。
zh_hant: 因為那聽起來真的很好玩，我喜歡派對。

text: Let's recap the vocabulary we heard during the conversation,
zh: 让我们回顾一下对话中听到的词汇，
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下對話中聽到的詞彙，

text: starting with bustling, which means busy,
with lots of people and activity.
We also heard convenient.
If something is convenient, it means it's very easy to do it.
zh: 如果某样东西是convenient，就是做起来很容易。
zh_hant: 如果某樣東西是convenient，就是做起來很容易。

text: For example, there's lots of public transport in London,
zh: 例如，伦敦有很多公共交通，
zh_hant: 例如，倫敦有很多公共交通，

text: so it's convenient for travel.
And we talked about possible plans for the future using "would like to".
zh: 我们还用“would like to”谈论了未来可能的计划。
zh_hant: 我們還用“would like to”談論了未來可能的計劃。

text: For example, I'd like to visit Tbilisi in Georgia.
zh: 比如，我想去格鲁吉亚的第比利斯看看。
zh_hant: 比如，我想去喬治亞的第比利斯看看。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English,
zh: 本期《真实简单英语》就到这里，
zh_hant: 本期《真實簡單英語》就到這裡，

text: but we'll be back next week with another conversation in Easy English.
zh: 但下周我们会带着另一段简单英语对话回来。
zh_hant: 但下週我們會帶著另一段簡單英語對話回來。

text: And you should check out our series, The London to Edinburgh Challenge.
zh: 你们应该看看我们的系列节目《伦敦到爱丁堡挑战》。
zh_hant: 你們應該看看我們的系列節目《倫敦到愛丁堡挑戰》。

text: We've been talking about Edinburgh today.
zh: 今天我们聊到了爱丁堡。
zh_hant: 今天我們聊到了愛丁堡。

text: It's a beautiful place, and you can see it in this series.
zh: 那是个美丽的地方，你能在这个系列中看到它。
zh_hant: 那是個美麗的地方，你能在這個系列中看到它。

text: It's on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
Goodbye for now.
Goodbye.
